trig c refers to the task of trigger word identification and classification in event extraction
arg c refers to the task of argument identification and classification in event extraction
text2event is an event extraction model used as a baseline for comparison in the experiments
hdgse is an event extraction model used as a baseline for comparison in the experiments
ace05 e  is a dataset used for testing event extraction models and data augmentation methods
ere en is a dataset with more events and roles than ace05 e   used for testing event extraction models
f1 is an evaluation metric used to measure the performance of event extraction models on tasks like trig c and arg c
